_adr_diagrams: `diagrams` (added for MermaidDiagramVisualizations.md #1) owns the diagram INTERMEDIATE REPRESENTATION and everything deterministic built on it: the IR → Mermaid emitter, the Mermaid → IR reader, the syntax/semantic/style/accessibility validators, the quality score, the layout planner, the edit applier, version history and the PlantUML/DOT/Draw.io/ELK exporters. It is a separate package rather than more of `response_arch` because it is an ARTIFACT COMPILER, not part of answer shaping: `response_arch.mermaid` lints and renders a mermaid STRING inside a response lane, whereas this package's contract is that the model never emits final syntax at all. Keeping it separate is also what makes the doc's #18 ("extend the same pipeline beyond Mermaid") cheap — a PlantUML- or BPMN-first artifact reuses the IR, validators and versioning without touching the response pipeline. Model access is confined to `diagrams/planner.py` and `diagrams/critic.py`; every other module is pure and unit-tested without a model.
